accepted.reason: Debian has not yet triaged this CVE for trixie (no fixed build, no no-dsa decision); the system SQLite library is only a dependency of util-linux lastlog2. Short expiry: revisit when Debian triages it.
accepted.reachability: In the server image libsqlite3-0 is pulled in only by liblastlog2-2; the only binaries linked against it are /usr/bin/lslogins and liblastlog2, which the server never runs. accepted.reason: Debian marks this CVE no-dsa (minor issue) for trixie and ships no fixed build; the heap overflow needs an FTS5 table with detail=none filled with attacker-chosen rowids and a prefix MATCH on it.
accepted.reachability: libsqlite3-0 backs Python's sqlite3 module. Neither service imports it; of the installed packages only filelock (lock files) and torch (local caches) do, and nothing in the image creates or queries an FTS5 table, let alone with request data. The default process is UID 1000 (app).

accepted.reason: Debian has not yet triaged this CVE for trixie (open, no fixed build, no no-dsa decision; sid has 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.2-4). The overflow is in zlib's gzFile write path (gz_write after a failed write()). Short expiry: revisit when Debian ships the trixie fix.
accepted.reachability: The server process is the official Node 22 binary, which links its own bundled zlib (node_shared_zlib false, no libz.so.1 in its link map), so no request path reaches the system zlib1g. libz.so.1 is loaded only by Debian tooling (apt, dpkg and their helpers), which the server never runs and which cannot install anything as the default process, UID 1000 (node).
